verdict.rationale: Stripe Agentic Commerce is payments and commerce infrastructure that agents call into, not an agent host that consumes external tools, so plugging in third-party MCP servers is the wrong axis for this product. The evidence shows only the server role (Stripe's own hosted MCP server at mcp.stripe.com, which agents connect to). That does not count toward the MCP-client story, and nothing shows the product acting as an MCP client.
